turns.content: Relate (E)-N-methyl-N-(pentan-2-ylidene)ethanaminium to its parent carbonyl compound and state the goal of regioselective alpha ethylation.
Outline how deprotonation, carbon-carbon bond formation, and acidic hydrolysis will be followed through the sequence.
Identify the carbonyl functionality that must be regenerated when the functionalized iminium/enamine is hydrolyzed.
With LDA in DME, identify the alpha position deprotonated and the resulting carbon nucleophile.
Show the new carbon-carbon bond formed when that intermediate reacts with ethyl iodide.
After H3O+ hydrolysis, give the condensed structure and IUPAC name of the ketone.
State the complete reagent order and resulting ketone.
Check the carbon skeleton and hydrolysis step against the established intermediates.
Report the ordered sequence and final product.
